topic: Metric calculation load and data handling
summary_markdown:
The current metric calculation process is resource-intensive. Metrics for active campaigns are recalculated every six hours, which was the cause of previously empty data. Furthermore, metrics are being calculated for test campaigns (which span a full year with all frames), even though this data is not required by anyone. This practice significantly loads the servers. The team also faces pressure to provide hourly metrics and calculate/store them, adding further load.

It was noted that metric data for screen reports is currently stored in the database on a daily basis.
action_items: Investigate what specific data is missing from the production environment (prod) for proper calculation.
